card.name: Daytime impairment and list-style names
card.fires_on: Partway through fixed phrases: the word "time" in "Daytime impairment", and "for" in "Criteria for Adverse Events". It also fires on name or drug lists, such as crew names and "amphetamines".

modes.label: Daytime impairment
modes.description: The word time or daytime/morning in warnings about next-day impairment or sleepiness.
modes.example: CNS-Depressant Effects and Day<<time>> Impairment: Impairs alertness

modes.label: Criteria for Adverse Events
modes.description: The word "for" inside the standard grading-criteria title in dose modification tables.
modes.example: National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria<< for>> Adverse Events version 4.0

modes.label: Items in a list
modes.description: A name or separator in a list of crew members or drug names.
modes.example: Rick Husband, commander;<< Michael>> Anderson, payload commander
